admission.justification: One reviewer request reusing its own private-index capture baseline. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

applicability: One reviewer request reusing its own private-index capture baseline.
conditions: Repository HEAD, index evidence and the same worktree snapshot are rechecked.
An unreadable or changed operand forces re-derivation or the owner refusal.
exclusions: A baseline is not reusable across requests or as a kept composed review.
statement: The existing request-scoped capture baseline includes the memory HEAD observed around capture and checks it natively before reuse; HEAD-only movement with identical files/index refuses a stale review, while subject reads stay within the eighty-child subject-read budget the current tests use.
